November 6, 1969 


LADY ENTERS 
Y JOG FOR $ 


Remember the female Invasion of "Le Gobelet?" It's 
that rather plush tavern In the North East section of 
Montreal which, earlier this year, was invaded by a gror- 
of light-hearted young ladies, all demanding to be served. 


One of the leaders of the foray, Melle Yolande Soucy, 
is readying a new drive into all-male territory, but 
this time she'!|l be an honored guest. 


Melle Soucy, Public Relations Assistant at the Montreal 
YMCA, will this coming Wednesday, November 12, at noon, 
change from mini skirt into gym shorts and running shoes, 
to become the first young lady to participate in the Dow- 
town YMCA's Joggathon. 


The Joggathon to run into the end of the month, was 
organized by the Y to help raise funds to support a far- 
sighted youth project in Guyana, South America. 


Participants find sponsors who contribute fixed sums 
for every mile logged by their proteges in the gym. 


Melle Soucy's efforts will be underwritten by Terry 
Hendershot a Marathoner and member of the Y's Bustness 
Men's Health Club. 


He has committed himself to donate $1.00 for every 
125-yard circult completed by Melle Soucy, equivalent of 
$28.00 a mile. 


For more information please contact: Bil! Sher 
849-5331 Local 742
